name: m2t8-fog-of-war-minimap
description: Fog-of-war fixture on an open all-grass field: a player-zero town center plus two villagers anchor a starting explored ring while a scout-cavalry (sight 8) marches east across unexplored ground toward an unseen player-one barracks and house. Milestone samples pin the plane progression (unexplored black → sighted bright → dim ghost), KnowledgeView sighting of the enemy buildings, their memory ghosts after the scout returns west, and exact minimap tri-state projection over every sampled tile. An explored-tile house placement succeeds mid-run while the same call-site rejects far unexplored ground. Digests land every 30th tick plus final under BOTH the real fog planes and the M1 all-visible stub (observational-neutrality parity), doubling as the extended determinism canary.
